body.heading: Where in the world is Peru?
paragraphs: Peru is a country in South America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Peru is Lima.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Peru is Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Peru is the Peruvian sol.

body.heading: How big is Peru?
paragraphs: Peru covers about 1,285,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Argentina.

body.heading: A fact to wow your friends
paragraphs: Machu Picchu is an Inca-era site high in Peru’s Andes Mountains. Nobody knows exactly why the Inca built it — a royal estate, a sacred place, or both. Its stones fit together so tightly that a knife blade cannot slip between them.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Machu Picchu is the Incas' mountain citadel — stone temples and terraces in the clouds above the Urubamba River, reached by train or the Inca Trail.
Cusco was the Inca capital — its streets pair Inca stone walls with Spanish churches, and the Sacred Valley holds markets, salt terraces and fortresses.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Peru on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
